notes: Single trials under concurrent machine load; timings do not establish throughput or regression.
Rust allocator counters exclude allocations outside the global allocator.
Sampled process-tree RSS, kernel maximum RSS, and peak live Rust heap are distinct.
Missing phase receipts are incomplete evidence, not zero cost.
Extent-only controls materialize scalar extents with identical independent symbolic input declarations; they do not replace full tensor-broadcast validation.
Baseline phase probe prints expanded-node counts as nodes=N; candidate prints the same count as JSON.
